title: A Joomla import whose token reaches no Claude Cowork door stops as cowork_not_answering, before registering or reading
steps: S1: Run the real startRun (packages/site/tracy-add-site/src/host/run.ts) for a Joomla site with a pasted token and webRootUrl, fetch mocked: the front door answers 404 {"error":true,"code":404,"message":"Komponente nicht gefunden"}, the administrator door answers 401.
S2: Read the settled run state and the recorded requests.
expect: S1: the run settles with state error and error cowork_not_answering.
S2: both doors were asked for info twice (4 calls), no PUT to /component-credential, no db.tables or files.pack call.
evidence: Production 19/10/2026, yido.eu: three pasted-token imports ended call_failed in 4 s; com_claudecowork was not on the site and three dead site_component rows were registered
fence: The door check between getting a token and registering it: a run with no answering door never registers a credential or reads

tests: a pasted token no door answers on stops as cowork_not_answering
